# Changelog

Release notes are written in Chinese, in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/rootSunc/CNEquity/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) at the repository root and on the [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/rootSunc/CNEquity/releases) page. Each entry starts with the upgrade steps for that version, followed by user-visible changes and fixes.

Before upgrading, read the notes for every version between yours and the target, then follow [Installation and upgrades](getting-started/installation.md#upgrades-and-compatibility).
